Out of room PM's work in all cases

This allows bots without running databases to know who users that PM

getpicture, userinfo, getuserid commands

- getpicture [username]: Attempts to find a profile picture for that
user (any user on TT)
- userinfo [username]: Gives information on any user on TT
- getuserid [username]: Gets the userid of any user on TT

These commands require the most recent version of TTAPI on GitHub.

Partial DJ tracking - fixes #32

- Adds a partialdj list
- Users are added to this list if they don't play all their allotted
songs
- Users are kept in this list for the # of songs they'd play + any wait
time
- If a user steps up while on this list, their songs to play will be
what it was before, instead of the full #
- Untested, so let me know of any bugs that arise from it

Added banlist

- Uses MySQL DB (adds a new table BANNED_USERS)
- Commands: addban [username], listbans, unbanuser [username]
- Commands usable only by bot owner for now

Added SparkleConfig.app

SparkleConfig.app is a quick/dirty way for OSX users to generate a
config file. I'm planning on making it much nicer in the future, but
this is a nice alternative to manually fighting through a JSON file.
Make sure all information is correct before generating the output file
- there's no bounds checking yet. It currently saves to your Home
folder (that will change in the future as well).
Fixed a missing comma in the sample config

Waitlist implementation and other improvements

- Sends a welcome PM to users the bot hasn't seen in 36 hours
- Option to log chat
- Moderators list now maintained
- djinfo shows # of songs played if enforcement is off
- Scott Pilgrim quote commands/table
- setavatar command to change bot avatar
- Bot now responds to custom bot name instead of "meow"
- Reference for bootuser command

Waitlist commands:
- .add, .addme, +q: Adds user to queue
- .rem, .remove, .removeme, -q: Removes user from queue
- shiftq, .shiftq, shiftqueue, .removefirst: Removes the first user
from the waitlist (if they're gone/afk, for example)
- .position: Shows your position in the waitlist
- .pq, printqueue: Prints the waitlist
